[\> turning data into decisions]{.lead-mono}

I hold a **Master's in Physics from UFJF** (Materials Science) and a **postgraduate degree in Data Science**, with **12 published projects** ranging from relational SQL models to apps in production.
Physics taught me the rigor of the scientific method: forming hypotheses, measuring carefully and distrusting results
that look too good. Today I apply that foundation with **Python, SQL, statistics and machine learning** to solve business
problems end to end, from data exploration to communicating results.

I am looking for opportunities as a **Junior Data Scientist** or **Data Analyst**.
